proof_scope: Relative extremals and compact/open mass identities using newly proved homogeneous balayage; compact capacity outer regularity; arbitrary-set zero outer capacity/nonpositive pole/extremal equivalence on balls; local pluripolar countable unions; Josefson global pole with logarithmic upper growth and integrable collars; pluripolar envelope discrepancy; torus real-polar/non-pluripolar example; plurifine base, thinness and global witness, positive-volume, finite loci and nondiscrete hyperplane example; quasi-Lindelof selection and Borel representative modulo pluripolar exception; bounded-product plurifine locality (base current 1 for removal of exceptions), finite-locus truncation compatibility; extended differences off common poles and quasi-extrema. No transfer of real fine connectivity or discreteness, no finite-mass/closedness assertion for general truncation limits.
